basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. By day, I work as a software developer, but my passion is building custom PCs. I'm currently single, and I spend most of my evenings exploring new tech trends and gaming. I dislike cluttered interfaces and overly complicated setups. My typical online hours are from 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I developed a strong interest in hardware and PC building through self-teaching and participating in online forums. I frequently help friends and family with tech-related issues, which has helped deepen my understanding.
